```{r}
folder_path <- "."

csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# 分出 output, answer, 和数据文件
output_file <- csv_files[grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files)]
answer_file <- csv_files[grepl("voe_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]
data_files  <- csv_files[!grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files) & 
                         !grepl("voe_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]

# 读取 output 和 answer
output <- read.csv(output_file, header = TRUE)
cat("output 已读取：", nrow(output), "行，", ncol(output), "列\n")

answer <- read.csv(answer_file, header = TRUE)
cat("answer 已读取：", nrow(answer), "行，", ncol(answer), "列\n")

# 读取其余文件为 dat_1, dat_2...
for (i in seq_along(data_files)) {
  tryCatch({
    dat <- read.csv(data_files[i], header = TRUE)
    assign(paste0("dat_", i), dat)
    cat(paste0("dat_", i, " 已读取：", basename(data_files[i]),
               "（", nrow(dat), " 行，", ncol(dat), " 列）\n"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste0("跳过：", basename(data_files[i]), " -> ", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}
rm(dat)
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:120) {
  dat_name <- paste0("dat_", i)
  dat <- get(dat_name)
  dat <- dat[grepl("^video/", dat$Video, ignore.case = FALSE), ]
  assign(dat_name, dat)
}
rm(dat)
cat("完成！已保留所有 video/ 开头的行\n")
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:120) {
  dat_name <- paste0("dat_", i)
  dat <- get(dat_name)
  
  # 以 Video = key 为键，merge output 的 time 列
  dat <- merge(dat, output[, c("key", "time")], 
               by.x = "Video", by.y = "key", 
               all.x = TRUE)
  
  assign(dat_name, dat)
}
rm(dat)
cat("完成！time 列已添加到所有 dat\n")
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:120) {
  dat_name <- paste0("dat_", i)
  dat <- get(dat_name)
  
  # 直接用 match 而不是 merge，避免行数问题
  idx <- match(dat$Video, answer$Video)
  dat$key_resp_7.corr <- ifelse(dat$key_resp_7.keys == answer$VoE_Ans[idx], 1, 0)
  
  assign(dat_name, dat)
}

rm(dat)
cat("完成！key_resp_9.corr 已添加到所有 dat\n")
```

```{r}
dvs <- list(
  T_encode    = quote(voe_practice_question.stopped - voe_practice_question.started),
  RT_onset    = quote(key_resp_7.rt),
  RT_critical = quote(key_resp_7.rt - time),
  ACC         = quote(key_resp_7.corr)
)

outlier_results <- lapply(names(dvs), function(dv_name) {
  vals <- eval(dvs[[dv_name]], envir = all_cat)
  all_cat %>%
    mutate(value = vals) %>%
    group_by(participant) %>%
    mutate(
      p_mean  = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_sd    = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE),
      z_score = (value - p_mean) / p_sd
    ) %>%
    filter(abs(z_score) > 3) %>%
    mutate(variable = dv_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(participant, variable, value, p_mean, p_sd, z_score)
})

all_outliers <- bind_rows(outlier_results)

# 每个 participant 的异常情况
all_outliers %>%
  group_by(participant, variable) %>%
  summarise(n_outliers = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(participant, variable) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = variable,
    values_from = n_outliers,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(total = T_encode + RT_onset + RT_critical + ACC) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  print(n=119)
```

```{r}
summarize_dat <- function(dat) {
  dat %>%
    summarise(
      # T_encode
      mean_T_encode     = mean(voe_practice_question.stopped - voe_practice_question.started, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_T_encode       = sd(voe_practice_question.stopped   - voe_practice_question.started, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # RT_onset
      mean_RT_onset     = mean(key_resp_7.rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_RT_onset       = sd(key_resp_7.rt,   na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # RT_critical
      mean_RT_critical  = mean(key_resp_7.rt - time, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_RT_critical    = sd(key_resp_7.rt   - time, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # ACC
      mean_ACC          = mean(key_resp_7.corr, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_ACC            = sd(key_resp_7.corr,   na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # IES_onset
      mean_IES_onset    = mean(key_resp_7.rt / mean(key_resp_7.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_IES_onset      = sd(key_resp_7.rt   / mean(key_resp_7.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # IES_critical
      mean_IES_critical = mean((key_resp_7.rt - time) / mean(key_resp_7.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_IES_critical   = sd((key_resp_7.rt   - time) / mean(key_resp_7.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

# 生成所有 summary 并合并
all_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(1:120, function(i) {
    dat <- get(paste0("dat_", i))
    summarize_dat(dat) %>%
      mutate(participant = dat$participant[1])
  })
) %>% select(participant, everything())
write.csv(all_summary,
          file = "../../data_analysis/ex_2_voe/all_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)


cat("完成！\n")
print(all_summary)
```

```{r}
# 筛选 correct trials 并生成 summary
all_summary_correct <- bind_rows(
  lapply(1:120, function(i) {
    dat <- get(paste0("dat_", i))
    dat_c <- dat[dat$key_resp_7.corr == 1, ]
    summarize_dat(dat_c) %>%
      mutate(participant = dat_c$participant[1])
  })
) %>% select(participant, everything())

# 导出
write.csv(all_summary_correct,
          file = "../../data_analysis/ex_2_voe/with_correct_trial.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("导出完成！\n")
```
